experience.title: Machine Learning Research Intern
canonical_bullets: Built a data pipeline that cleaned and merged 5 heterogeneous lab datasets into one training-ready corpus.
Trained a baseline classification model and improved its validation F1 score from 0.71 to 0.84 through feature engineering.
Wrote automated tests that reduced a recurring data-pipeline regression from happening roughly weekly to zero over 3 months.
Presented findings in a lab-wide seminar and incorporated feedback into a revised experiment design.

experience.title: AI Engineer Intern
alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Built an internal tool that automated a manual data-labeling step, cutting labeling turnaround time from 2 days to 4 hours.
Integrated a vector database into an internal search prototype and added evaluation scripts the team still uses.

projects.name: Project Atlas
projects.description: Document-classification pipeline with a labeling/evaluation harness.
canonical_bullets: Designed a document-classification pipeline covering 6 document categories with a held-out accuracy of 91%.
Built a labeling and evaluation harness that cut manual QA time by half compared to the initial spreadsheet-based process.
Wrote unit and integration tests achieving 85% coverage of the pipeline's core modules.

projects.name: Project Beacon
canonical_bullets: Implemented a recommendation prototype using collaborative filtering over a public 100k-rating dataset.
Improved offline NDCG@10 from 0.41 to 0.53 through hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering.
Packaged the prototype as a reproducible CLI with a documented evaluation harness.

projects.name: Project Meridian
alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Built a retrieval-augmented question-answering service over a 50k-document corpus using hybrid (BM25 + dense) search.
Reduced p95 query latency from 480ms to 190ms by adding an approximate nearest-neighbor index.

projects.name: Project Horizon
projects.description: Time-series demand-forecasting model for a simulated logistics network.
alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Built a time-series demand-forecasting model for a simulated regional logistics network, reducing forecast error (MAPE) from 19% to 11% versus a naive seasonal baseline.
Packaged the forecasting model behind a weekly batch-scoring script that regenerated demand forecasts across 12 simulated distribution regions.

projects.name: Project Solstice
alternate_bullets_for_dynamic_tailoring: Built an ETL data-quality validation framework that automatically checked schema drift and null-rate anomalies across 8 simulated data sources.
Reduced manual data-quality review time by 70% by auto-flagging anomalous batches before they reached a downstream warehouse table.
